description: Unit-anchored economics conversation (SpaceX IPO). Chatty older scholar who keeps pulling toward valuation. Tests whether steering toward UNPROBED granules drags the tutor off the scholar's live thread.

turns.content: ok so my dad said spacex is worth like 350 billion dollars but they dont even sell tickets to space yet. how does that work
but thats just made up then? if they dont make that money yet
i guess people are betting it'll be huge later. like starlink and mars stuff
wait so two smart investors could look at the SAME company and say totally different numbers?
that feels broken. shouldnt there be one right answer
hm. ok so maybe the disagreement is the point. but then how does anyone ever decide to buy
